title: 第19章 无瑕之骨第20章 霓裳血衣
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
在这白骨森森，一片狼藉的战场，叶凌又开始了捡垃圾生涯。
这一点确实很无奈，就算是再强大的御灵使，击败了魔物，都需要自己或者灵宠去搜刮那些掉落的材料。
没有人能够例外的。
因此这也导致有一个问题，那就是有可能一波人正在进攻一个魔物，好不容易消灭掉了对方。
正准备搜刮材料的时候，却有另一方人坐收渔翁之利，在他们搜刮不及的时候，将东西顺走。
这种情况发生的次数，还不在少数。
这样搜刮材料，不仅很慢，而且没有保证。
万一自己漏了点什么，有可能自己也不知道。
如果自己的这个系统，有自动拾取功能就好了。
叶凌一边搜刮着材料，一边这样想到。
就在这时，叶凌脑海之中突然接到了来自于系统的提示。
“检测到目前宿主的需求，任务发布，成功将等级提升至二阶一级，可开放功能——自动拾取，奖励神秘道具一份。”
在听到这个提示的时候，叶凌甚至都一度以为自己是不是听错了。
自己只不过是想一想这个自动拾取功能而已，没想到系统竟然真的有。
这完全出乎了叶凌的意料。
他怎么也没想到，系统竟然还会根据自己的需求，发布特定的任务。
那如果自己缺什么材料，然后想一想，那么系统会不会发布相应的任务，给自己材料呢？
想到这里，叶凌准备尝试一下。
心中开始幻想血幽净化所需要的材料。
然而，系统完全没有任何动静，一片沉寂。

最终，叶凌也没有得到系统发布的这种任务。
看来，这并不是系统的bug，而是确实是有这种功能。
不过这种功能，暂时并没有开放而已。
要想开放自动拾取功能，还必须要提升到二阶一级。
以现目前自己的实力来说，还有点任重而道远。
要知道自己现在也不过才一阶三级。
在这几天之内，要想分到二阶一级，虽然不是没有可能，但难度非常之大。
就在这时，突然一抹淡淡的白光，吸引了叶凌的注意力。
在一个骷髅军士的骨架之下，似乎有什么东西正散发着一种淡淡的乳白色的微光。
转身走了过去，叶凌来到骷髅军士的骨架之前，缓缓的蹲下身。
将骷髅军士的骨架翻开，一节手指长的，散发着白色微光的白骨，映入眼帘。
将这根白骨捡起来，叶凌终于确定了这是什么东西。
content_en:
In this messy battlefield filled with bones and bones, Ye Ling started his career of picking up garbage again.
This is really helpless. No matter how powerful the spirit master is, if he defeats the monster, he still needs to collect the dropped materials by himself or his spirit pet.
No one can be an exception.
Therefore, this also leads to a problem, that is, it is possible that a wave of people is attacking a monster and finally destroys it.
When they were about to search for materials, someone on the other side took advantage of them and took the things away when they couldn't search enough.
This has happened quite a few times.
Searching for materials in this way is not only very slow, but also not guaranteed.
If I missed something, I might not even know it.
It would be great if this system of my own had an automatic picking function.
Ye Ling thought this while searching for materials.
At this moment, Ye Ling suddenly received a prompt from the system in his mind.
"After detecting the needs of the current host, the mission was released, and the level was successfully upgraded to Level 2 and Level 1. The function can be opened - automatic pickup, and a mysterious prop will be rewarded."
When he heard this prompt, Ye Ling even thought that he had heard it wrong.
I just thought about this automatic pickup function, but I didn't expect that the system actually has it.
This was completely beyond Ye Ling's expectation.
He never expected that the system would issue specific tasks based on his needs.
So if you are short of any materials, then think about it, will the system issue corresponding tasks and give you the materials?
Thinking of this, Ye Ling was ready to give it a try.
He began to fantasize about the materials needed for blood purification.
However, the system was completely silent and silent.
In the end, Ye Ling did not get this kind of task issued by the system.
It seems that this is not a bug in the system, but that it does have this function.
However, this function is not available yet.
If you want to enable the automatic pickup function, you must upgrade to Level 2 and Level 1.
Judging from the current strength, there is still a long way to go.
You must know that you are only at level one or level three now.
In the past few days, it is not impossible to get to the second level and the first level, but it is very difficult.
At this moment, a sudden flash of white light attracted Ye Ling's attention.
Under the skeleton of a skeleton sergeant, something seemed to be emitting a faint milky white shimmer.
Turning around and walking over, Ye Ling came to the skeleton of the skeleton sergeant and slowly squatted down.
Opening the skeleton of the Skeleton Sergeant, a finger-long white bone with white shimmer came into view.
Picking up the bone, Ye Ling finally determined what it was.
